blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Digital image transmission typically optimizes source coding, channel coding, and modulation separately, limiting how source representations adapt to channel impairments. We propose SemQAM, a joint semantic-channel coding and modulation scheme for generative image transmission converting source to modulated symbols, such as standard QAM symbols. Channel impairments create two challenges: they can corrupt the latent representation at the receiver, and this corruption can compound through autoregressive coding, degrading reconstruction quality. First, SemQAM represents latent features with vector quantization (VQ), maps each VQ index to a QAM symbol, and updates the codeword corresponding to the detected symbol so that channel impairments directly affect codebook learning. Moreover, SemQAM uses the conditional expectation of received codewords to approximate the receiver reconstruction and reduce error propagation during autoregressive coding. SemQAM supports multiple SNRs and CBRs in a unified model, while also supporting conventional source coding through SemQAM-C. Experiments show that (i) under the same LDPC and QAM settings, SemQAM-C outperforms OneDC in LPIPS and DISTS with substantially lower complexity, showing that the unified model retains competitive capability for source coding. (ii) Compared with this separated counterpart, SemQAM reduces channel uses by 18.57% at matched LPIPS and outperforms the compared JSCC methods, demonstrating the benefit of joint coding.
blocks.zh: 数字图像传输一般会优化出源编码,通道编码,并分别调制,限制出源表示如何适应通道减值. 我们提出"SemQAM",是一种用于基因图像传输的联合语义-通道编码和调制方案,将源转换为调制符号,如标准QAM符号. 通道障碍带来了两个挑战:它们会腐蚀接收者的潜在代表,这种腐败会通过自旋编码而加剧,使重建质量下降。 首先,SemQAM以向量量化(VQ)代表了潜在的特征,将每个VQ指数映射到QAM符号上,并更新了与被检测到的符号对应的代码词,使通道减值会直接影响代码簿的学习. 此外,SemQAM使用对收到的密码词的有条件期望来取近似接收器重建,并减少自递编码过程中出错的传播. SemQAM在一个统一的模型中支持多个SNR和CBR,同时也通过SemQAM-C支持常规源编码. 实验显示(一)在同一LDPC和QAM设置下,SemQAM-C在LPIPS和DISTS中比OneDC要复杂得多,表明统一模型保留了源编码的竞争能力. (二) 与这个分离的对应方相比,SemQAM在匹配的LPIPS时将信道使用量减少了18.57%,并且超过了比较的JSC方法,显示了联合编码的好处.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Digital image transmission is an important application of modern communication systems [ 22 , 48 ] .
A conventional digital image transmission system consists of three separately optimized stages, as illustrated in Fig. 1(a) .
(i) Source coding [ 41 ] compresses an image into as few bits as possible at the desired reconstruction quality.
(ii) Channel coding [ 40 , 21 ] adds redundancy to protect these bits from transmission errors.
(iii) Modulation [ 24 ] maps the protected bits to channel symbols, such as quadrature amplitude modulation (QAM) symbols, for transmission.
blocks.zh:
数字图像传输是现代通信系统的重要应用[22,48].
如图1(a)所示,传统的数字图像传输系统由三个单独优化的阶段组成。
(一)源码 [41] 将一个图像压缩成尽可能少的位数,达到理想的重建质量.
(二)通道编码 [40, 21] 增加冗余,以保护这些位元不发生传输错误.
(三)调制 [24] 将受保护的位点映射到通道符号,如四振幅调制(QAM)符号,用于传输.

blocks.en:
However, with limited transmission resources, source representation and error protection compete for the budget, motivating learned joint semantic-channel coding (JSCC) [ 13 , 26 ] and joint semantic-channel coding and modulation (JSCM) [ 53 , 52 ] for end-to-end optimization of the transmission system.
How QAM detection errors alter the latent representation reconstructed at the receiver and propagate through autoregressive coding remains less explored.
blocks.zh:
然而,由于传输资源有限,源表示和错误保护争夺预算,激发了学习到的联合语义-通道编码(JSCC)[13,26]和联合语义-通道编码和调制(JSCM)[53,52]对传输系统的端到端优化.
QAM检测错误如何改变在接收器上重建并通过自动回转编码传播的潜在表达方式,仍然较少探索。

blocks.en:
In this paper, we propose SemQAM, a joint sem antic-channel coding and modulation system for generative image transmission using QAM , as illustrated in Fig. 1(b) .
Channel impairments degrade reconstruction quality for two reasons: they corrupt the latent representation reconstructed at the receiver, and the resulting corruption further compounds during autoregressive coding.
First, SemQAM maps vector quantization (VQ) indices of image latents to QAM symbols and updates the codeword corresponding to the detected symbol.
Second, SemQAM computes the expected received codeword from channel transition probabilities and uses it for subsequent autoregressive encoding.
Together, these designs adapt the latent representation to channel impairments and reduce corruption accumulation during autoregressive coding, improving reconstruction quality.
blocks.zh:
在本文中,我们提出SemQAM,即一个使用QAM进行基因图像传输的联合的Sem antic-channel编码和调制系统,如图1(b)所示。
通道受损使重建质量下降有两个原因:它们腐蚀了在接收器上重建的潜在代表,以及由此产生的在自动编码过程中的进一步腐败。
首先,SemQAM将图像潜伏指数的矢量定量(VQ)映射到QAM符号,并更新对应被检测到的符号的代码.
第二,SemQAM从信道过渡概率计算预期收到的密码词,并用它来进行后续的自动递归编码.
这些设计加在一起,使潜在的代表方式适应于引导障碍,减少自旋编码过程中的腐败积累,提高重建质量.

blocks.en:
SemQAM supports multiple signal-to-noise ratios (SNRs) and channel bandwidth ratios (CBRs) in a unified model, while also providing a noiseless source-coding mode, SemQAM-C, to accommodate diverse transmission scenarios.
Experiments on Kodak at 10 dB show that (i) under the same LDPC [ 21 , 39 ] and QAM, OneDC [ 50 ] requires 20.96% and 17.01% more channel uses than SemQAM-C at matched LPIPS and DISTS, respectively, while SemQAM-C uses only 5.59% of the encoder latency, 2.59% of the decoder latency, and 4.29% of the parameters, showing that the unified model preserves competitive capability for source coding.
(ii) SemQAM outperforms the compared JSCC methods in LPIPS [ 54 ] , DISTS [ 15 ] , and FID [ 25 ] , and reduces channel uses by 18.57% on average at matched LPIPS compared with the separated SemQAM-C system, directly demonstrating the advantage of joint coding over separate optimization.
blocks.zh:
SemQAM在一个统一的模型中支持多个信号对噪比(SNRs)和信道带宽比(CBRs),同时提供无噪声源编码模式SemQAM-C,以适应不同的传输情景.
Kodak在10 dB的实验显示(一)在同一LDPC[21,39]和QAM下,OneDC[50]分别需要比SemQAM-C在匹配的LPIPS和DISTS上多使用20.96%和17.01%的信道,而SemQAM-C只使用5.59%的编码机空位,2.59%的解码机空位,4.29%的参数,显示统一模型保持了源码的竞争能力.
(二)SemQAM在LPIPS [54],DISTS [15],FID [25]中比JSCC方法表现得更好,与分离的SemQAM-C系统相比,平均比对应的LPIPS减少18.57%的通道使用率,直接显示出联合编码比单独优化的优势.

blocks.en: Our contributions are summarized as follows:
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献概述如下:

blocks.en: • We introduce SemQAM, a joint semantic-channel coding and modulation system for generative image transmission with standard QAM, supporting multiple SNRs and CBRs as well as conventional source coding in a unified model. • SemQAM trains VQ codewords using detected indices to incorporate channel transitions into codebook learning, and uses expected received codewords to approximate receiver reconstructions and reduce error propagation. • Experiments demonstrate the advantage of joint coding over separate optimization while retaining strong performance and efficiency in conventional source coding.
blocks.zh: • 支助 我们引入了SemQAM,这是一种以标准QAM进行基因图像传输的联语-通道编码和调制系统,支持多个SNR和CBR以及常规源编码在一个统一的模型中. • SemQAM 培训 VQ 代码词,使用检测到的指数,将频道转换纳入代码簿学习,并使用预期收到的代码词,以大致了解接收器的重建并减少错误传播。 • 实验显示,联合编码比单独优化有优势,同时保留传统源编码的强性能和效率。

blocks.en: We introduce SemQAM, a joint semantic-channel coding and modulation system for generative image transmission with standard QAM, supporting multiple SNRs and CBRs as well as conventional source coding in a unified model.

blocks.en: 2 Preliminary
blocks.zh: 2 初步数据

blocks.en:
Digital image transmission aims to reconstruct the source image with high quality using as few transmitted symbols as possible.
During wireless transmission, channel impairments such as noise can distort the transmitted signals and cause symbol errors, so the system must represent the image efficiently while remaining robust to these errors.
blocks.zh:
数字图像传输旨在利用尽可能少的传输符号,高品质地重建源图像.
在无线传输过程中,噪音等通道障碍会扭曲传输的信号并引起符号错误,因此系统必须高效地代表图像,同时对这些错误保持坚固.

blocks.en:
Source coding removes redundancy from the source representation to reduce the number of bits or symbols needed for reconstruction.
Autoregressive coding reduces redundancy among latent features [ 4 , 37 ] .
In EF-LIC [ 10 ] , previously reconstructed groups predict an affine transform for the current latent before VQ, removing predictable information and improving representation efficiency under a fixed VQ budget.
This also makes later quantization depend on earlier reconstructions.
blocks.zh:
源代码取消了源表示值的冗余,以减少重建所需的位数或符号.
自动回转编码减少潜在特性之间的冗余[4,37].
在EF-LI[10]中,先前重建的小组预测,VQ之前的当前潜伏会发生类似变化,在固定VQ预算中删除可预测的信息并提高代表效率。
这也使得后来的量化依赖于早期的重建.

blocks.en:
Channel coding adds redundancy to transmitted bits so that the receiver can correct errors caused by channel impairments.
Low Density Parity Check (LDPC) codes [ 21 , 39 ] are among the most widely used channel codes in modern communication systems [ 27 ] .
We therefore use LDPC to construct the separated transmission baselines in our experiments.
blocks.zh:
通道编码在传输位元中添加冗余,以便接收器能够校正由通道减值引起的错误.
低密度对等检查(LDPC)代码[21,39]是现代通信系统中最广泛使用的频道代码[27].
因此,我们使用LDPC在实验中构建分离的传输基线.

blocks.en:
Modulation converts coded bits into physical signals for transmission over the wireless channel.
Quadrature amplitude modulation (QAM) [ 1 ] is one of the most widely used modulation schemes and maps coded bits to a finite set of constellation points.
An M M -QAM constellation contains M M points, so each symbol can represent log 2 ⁡ M \log_{2}M bits.
For example, 1024-QAM contains 1024 constellation points and carries 10 bits per symbol, naturally matching the 1024 possible indices of a VQ codebook.
blocks.zh:
模块化将编码的比特转换成物理信号,通过无线信道传输.
四方振幅调制(QAM)[1]是最广泛使用的调制方案之一,并将编码的位点映射到有限的一组星座点.
M-QAM星座包含M M点,因此每个符号可以代表log 2 QQM\log2}M位.
例如,1024-QAM包含1024个星座点,每个符号携带10比特,自然匹配VQ编码本的1024可能指数.

A common baseband channel model is r = h ​ s + N , r=hs+N, where s s and r r denote the transmitted and received symbols, h h denotes the channel response, and N N denotes additive noise.
The signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) is a common measure of channel conditions and is defined as SNR = 10 ​ log 10 ​ 𝔼 ⁡ [ | h ​ s | 2 ] 𝔼 ⁡ [ | N | 2 ] dB . \mathrm{SNR}=10\log_{10}\frac{\mathbb{E}[|hs|^{2}]}{\mathbb{E}[|N|^{2}]}\quad\mathrm{dB}. Under a fixed signal power, a larger SNR corresponds to weaker noise and a cleaner channel.
For digital image transmission, the channel bandwidth ratio (CBR) measures the transmission resources relative to the source image size.
For an RGB image of size H × W H\times W transmitted using n n channel uses, CBR is defined as CBR = n 3 ​ H ​ W , \mathrm{CBR}=\frac{n}{3HW}, where a lower CBR indicates fewer transmission resources.

blocks.en:
Separate source and channel coding is optimal only under restrictive asymptotic conditions, motivating learned joint transmission methods for practical systems with finite resources [ 41 , 32 ] .
Previous JSCC methods directly transmit continuous-valued encoded features [ 9 , 13 , 26 ] .
JSCM instead maps the encoded features to a finite set of digital constellation points.
Under otherwise matched conditions, this constraint reduces the available signal space and can lower the achievable performance relative to continuous JSCC, while making transmission compatible with practical digital systems.
As a widely used digital modulation scheme, QAM has been adopted by several JSCM methods [ 52 , 45 , 8 , 53 ] , making QAM-based JSCM compatible with existing communication systems.
blocks.zh:
单独源码和信道编码只有在限制性的不对称条件下才是最佳的,激发了为资源有限的实用系统而学习的联合传输方法[41、32]。
以前JSC的方法直接传输连续值编码的特性[9,13,26].
JSCM将编码的特征映射到一组有限的数字星座点。
在其他方面相匹配的条件下,这种制约会减少可用的信号空间,并可以降低相对于连续JSCC的可实现性能,同时使传输与实用的数字系统兼容.
作为广泛使用的数字调制方案,QAM已被几种JSCM方法采用[52,45,8,53],使得基于QAM的JSCM与现有的通信系统兼容.

blocks.en: 3.2 VQ Codebook Learning under Channel Impairments
blocks.zh: 3.2 在通道障碍下学习VQ代码本

blocks.en:
In a noiseless VQ system, codeword indices are only labels [ 46 ] .
Permuting these labels does not affect reconstruction as long as the encoder and decoder use the same mapping.
This symmetry is broken after the indices are mapped to QAM symbols because channel noise may change a transmitted index J J into a different detected index J ^ \hat{J} .
If a QAM detection error selects a codeword that is very different from the transmitted one, the reconstructed latent can change substantially, degrading the final image reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
在一个无噪声的VQ系统中,代码索引只是标签[46].
使用这些标签不会影响重建,只要编码器和解码器使用相同的映射.
这种对称性在指数被映射到QAM符号后被打破,因为信道噪声可能会将传输的索引J J改变为不同的检测索引J ^\ hat{J}.

blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en:
SemQAM uses four CBR settings for each of 10 dB, 16 dB, 24 dB, and noiseless transmission, giving sixteen codebook groups.
The noiseless variant is denoted as SemQAM-C for readability. It remains part of the same SemQAM model and shares the same weights.
We train SemQAM on ImageNet [ 14 ] using a three-stage multi-operating-point training strategy.
Detailed training settings are provided in Sec. C.1 .
blocks.zh:
SemQAM对10 dB,16 dB,24 dB各使用4个CBR设置,无噪声传输,给出16个代码组.
无噪声变体指SemQAM-C可读性. 它仍然是同一SemQAM模型的一部分,并共享相同的权重.
我们使用三阶段的多操作点训练策略,在ImageNet上培训SemQAM [14].
详细培训环境见Sec.C.1。

blocks.en:
We evaluate on Kodak, Tecnick, DIV2K validation, and CLIC 2020 Professional [ 16 , 3 , 2 , 44 ] using LPIPS, DISTS, and FID [ 54 , 15 , 25 ] .
We report CBR-based BD-rate [ 5 ] to measure the average transmission-resource difference at matched perceptual quality.
All methods follow the CBR definition in Sec. 2 , with required side information and padding overhead included.
Latency is measured on one NVIDIA A100, and SemQAM reports the mean CUDA latency across the evaluated CBR settings.
Metric, rate, and runtime protocols are provided in Secs. C.5 , C.4 and C.3 .
blocks.zh:
使用LPIPS、DISTS和FID[54、15、25]。
我们报告基于 CBR 的 BD 率 [5] ,以相应的感知质量衡量平均传输-资源差异.
所有方法都遵循第2节中的CBR定义,包括必要的侧面信息和铺垫间接费用。
NVIDIA A100测得空闲度,SemQAM报告经评价的CBR设置的平均空闲度。
计量、率和运行时间协议由Secs提供。 C.5、C.4和C.3 (中文(简体) ).

blocks.en:
We consider two groups of baselines for complementary comparisons.
(i) NTSCC, NTSCC+, MDJCM-A, and Quad-JSCC [ 13 , 47 , 53 , 26 ] are learned JSCC methods used to evaluate SemQAM against existing joint transmission systems.
(ii) MS-ILLM, OSCAR, OneDC, DiT-IC, EF-LIC, and CoD-Lite [ 38 , 23 , 50 , 42 , 10 , 30 ] are generative image codecs paired with LDPC and QAM with MCS table [ 1 ] in Sec. C.4 , forming separated systems for comparison of perceptual quality and transmission efficiency.
Following the common evaluation setting in learned image JSCC [ 13 , 47 , 26 ] , our main comparisons use the AWGN channel at 10 dB to enable broad comparison with existing methods.
Additional comparisons at 16 dB and 24 dB and baseline-specific configurations are provided in Secs. D.1 and C.3 .
blocks.zh:
我们认为有两组基线可作补充比较。
(一) NTSC、NTSC+、MDJCM-A和Quad-JSCC[13、47、53、26]是学习的JSC方法,用来对照现有的联合传输系统评估SemQAM。
(二)MS-ILLM,OSCAR,OneDC,DiT-IC,EF-LIC,和CoD-Lite[38,23,50,42,10,30]是基因图像编码器,与LDPC和QAM在Sec.C.4中与MCS表[1]对齐,形成分离的系统,以比较知觉质量和传输效率.
在学习成像的共同评价设定[13、47、26]之后,我们的主要比较利用特设工作组10 dB的频道,以便与现有方法进行广泛的比较。
16 dB和24 dB和基线具体配置的额外比较见Secs。 第D.1和第C.3段。

blocks.en: 4.2 Comparison with Previous Methods
blocks.zh: 4.2 与以往方法的比较

blocks.en:
Perceptual and generative JSCC methods remain relatively limited, and most evaluated JSCC baselines are optimized primarily for distortion rather than perceptual quality.
As shown in Figs. 2 and 1 , SemQAM substantially outperforms NTSCC, NTSCC+, and MDJCM-A in LPIPS, DISTS, and FID, and also achieves clear gains over the recent perceptual Quad-JSCC while requiring much lower inference latency.
Notably, conventional learned JSCC commonly allows unconstrained continuous-valued channel inputs, whose performance can be viewed as the limiting case approached by increasingly high modulation orders [ 45 , 8 , 52 ] .
Prior studies report that finite-constellation performance improves toward this continuous-input reference as the modulation order increases [ 45 , 8 ] .
SemQAM nevertheless achieves stronger perceptual performance while operating directly with finite 1024-QAM, demonstrating strong joint transmission capability under a discrete modulation constraint.
blocks.zh:
感知和遗传性JSC方法仍然相对有限,大多数评估的JSC基线主要为了扭曲而非感知质量而优化.
如图2和图1所示,SemQAM在LPIPS、DISTS和FID方面的业绩大大超过NTSC、NTSC+和MDJCM-A,并在近期的感知型Quad-JSCC方面也取得了明显收益,同时需要低得多的推论。
值得注意的是,传统学习的JSCC通常允许不受限制的连续价值的信道输入,其性能可被视为日益高调令[45,8,52]所接近的限制性案例.
先前的研究表明,随着调制令的增加[45,8],有限-星座性能在这种连续投入参考方面有所改进。
尽管如此,SemQAM在有限1024-QAM直接运行的同时,还是取得了更强的知觉性能,在离散调制限制下显示出强大的联合传输能力.

blocks.en:
The source-coding variant SemQAM-C performs strongly among the compared generative codecs, showing that the unified model retains strong conventional source-coding capability.
At 10 dB, SemQAM further improves over the separated SemQAM-C baseline.
This comparison demonstrates the benefit of jointly optimizing semantic coding, channel coding, and modulation under channel impairments.

这种比较显示了在信道减值下联合优化语义编码,信道编码和调制的好处.

blocks.en: 4.3 Constellation Usage Analysis
blocks.zh: 4.3 星座使用分析

blocks.en:
Fig. 3 shows that SemQAM learns strongly SNR-dependent symbol distributions without explicitly constraining either the VQ index probabilities or the QAM symbol usage.
At 10 dB, the distribution concentrates on the corner symbols, which have fewer directions in which noise can cause confusion than interior symbols.
Because the noise power is scaled with the average transmitted symbol power, using higher-energy corner symbols does not provide a higher operating SNR.
As the SNR increases, this preference weakens and the symbol usage becomes increasingly balanced, approaching a nearly uniform distribution in the noiseless setting.
This behavior appears without an explicit shaping objective, showing that symbol usage changes with SNR as a result of joint optimization.
We explain this behavior with information theory in Appendix A .
blocks.zh:
图3显示,SemQAM学习了强烈的SNR依赖的符号分布,但没有明确限制VQ指数概率或QAM符号使用.
在10 dB时,分布集中在角落符号上,这些符号的方向较少,噪声可以引起混淆,而不是内部符号.
由于噪声功率以平均传输符号功率进行缩放,使用更高的能量角符号并不能提供更高的操作SNR.
随着SNR的增加,这种偏好减弱,符号使用也越来越平衡,接近无声环境中的几乎统一分布.
这种行为出现时没有明确的塑造目标,表明由于联合优化,符号用法随SNR而变化.
我们用附录A的信息理论来解释这个行为。

blocks.en: 4.4 Effect of SNR at a Fixed CBR
blocks.zh: 4.4 SNR对固定CBR的影响

blocks.en:
As shown in Fig. 4 , SemQAM improves as the SNR increases from 10 dB to 16 dB and 24 dB across four datasets.
SemQAM maintains lower LPIPS than the compared generative image codecs paired with LDPC and QAM at every evaluated SNR, showing that its advantage persists across channel conditions under the same transmission budget.

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablation Studies
blocks.zh: 4.5 阅读研究

blocks.en:
We evaluate six configurations on Kodak at 10 dB under the same training protocol for a fair comparison, as detailed in Sec. C.7 . M 0 \mathrm{M}_{0} removes both the hyperprior (HP) and quadtree autoregressive context (AR), while M 1 \mathrm{M}_{1} increases the backbone capacity and M 2 \mathrm{M}_{2} restores the hyperprior.
With neither the hyperprior nor quadtree autoregressive context, the receiver-side codebook loss in M 0 \mathrm{M}_{0} and M 1 \mathrm{M}_{1} is equivalent in expectation to CAVQ [ 36 ] .
Starting from the complete model M 5 \mathrm{M}_{5} , M 3 \mathrm{M}_{3} replaces the expectation of received codewords with the transmitted codewords, while M 4 \mathrm{M}_{4} replaces the receiver-side codebook loss with a transmitter-side one.

blocks.en: 5 Related Work
blocks.zh: 5 相关工作

blocks.en:
Learned image JSCC do not use digital modulation, but directly transmit continuous symbols over the wireless channel [ 9 , 13 , 47 ] .
Quad-JSCC further provides generative reconstruction [ 26 ] .
SemQAM jointly optimizes generative image transmission under a fixed finite QAM constellation.
blocks.zh:
学到的图像JSC不使用数字调制,而是直接通过无线频道传送连续符号[9,13,47].
Quad-JSCC进一步提供基因重建[26].
在固定的有限QAM星座下,SemQAM联合优化了基因图像传输.

blocks.en:
DeepJSCC-Q constrains channel symbols to finite constellations, VQ-DeepSC transmits quantized features over digital channels, while JCM and MDJCM optimize symbol probabilities or multiple modulation orders [ 45 , 20 , 8 , 53 ] .
SemQAM instead maps VQ indices directly to standard QAM symbols and trains the representation using detected indices, adapting latent representation to channel impairments.
blocks.zh:
DeepJSCC-Q将频道符号限制在限定星座,VQ-DeepSC通过数字频道传输四分卫特征,而JCM和MDJCM则优化符号概率或多个调制命令[45,20,8,53].
SemQAM转而将VQ指数直接映射到标准的QAM符号上,并使用检测到的指数来训练表示,使潜在表示适应通道减值.

blocks.en:
Classical channel-optimized quantizers incorporate channel errors into index assignment and codebook optimization [ 18 , 19 ] , while CAVQ incorporates direct index transitions caused by channel errors into codebook learning [ 36 ] .
However, CAVQ does not model error propagation through autoregressive coding, while removing these dependencies leads to lower reconstruction performance in our experiments.
EF-LIC provides the autoregressive RVQ representation [ 10 ] , but assumes consistent transmitter and receiver reconstructions.
SemQAM uses Expected-RX to approximate receiver reconstructions at the transmitter, improving performance.
blocks.zh:
古典频道-优化量化器将频道错误纳入索引任务和代码集优化[18,19],而CAVQ将频道错误引起的直接索引转换纳入代码集学习[36].
然而,CAVQ并不通过自动递归编码来模型化错误传播,同时消除这些依赖性会导致我们实验中的重建性能下降.
EF-LIS提供自旋式RVQ代表[10],但承担一致的发射机和接收机重建.
SemQAM使用Expect-RX来估计发射机的接收器重建,提高了性能.

blocks.en: 6 Limitations
blocks.zh: 6. 限制

blocks.en:
Given finite resources, we prioritize 16 operating points that allow direct comparison with representative JSCC and JSCM evaluations [ 45 , 13 , 53 , 26 ] .
These operating points cover multiple CBRs and SNRs under AWGN, with the 10 dB AWGN condition used as the primary setting to align with them.
The two core designs of SemQAM are not specific to AWGN, since codebook learning uses detected indices and Expected-RX uses the corresponding transition probabilities.
Broader fading conditions and physical-layer settings such as OFDM may require more general transition modeling and remain for future evaluation.
blocks.zh:
鉴于资源有限,我们优先考虑16个业务点,以便与具有代表性的JSC和JSCM评价[45、13、53、26]进行直接比较。
这些操作点涵盖特设工作组之下的多个CBR和SNR,10 dB SWGN条件作为与这些条件一致的主要设置。
SemQAM的两种核心设计并不针对特设工作组,因为代码簿学习使用检测到的指数,而预期RX使用相应的过渡概率。
更广泛的消亡条件和实体层环境,如OFDM,可能需要更普遍的过渡模型,并留待今后评估。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en:
We presented SemQAM, a joint semantic-channel coding and modulation system for generative image transmission with standard QAM.
SemQAM trains VQ codewords using detected indices at the receiver, so transitions between transmitted and detected indices affect codebook learning, while symbol usage changes with SNR through joint optimization.
It uses the expectation of received codewords to approximate receiver reconstructions and reduce error propagation during autoregressive coding.
Experiments demonstrate the advantage of joint coding over separate optimization while retaining the performance and efficiency of conventional source coding, with SemQAM outperforming the compared JSCC methods under perceptual metrics.
blocks.zh:
我们提出了SemQAM, 一种用标准QAM进行基因图像传输的 联合语义-通道编码和调制系统。
SemQAM使用在接收器上检测到的指数来训练VQ编码词,因此传输指数和检测指数之间的过渡会影响代码簿的学习,而符号使用通过联合优化而随着SNR而变化.
它利用收到的密码词的预期来估计接收器的重建,并减少自递编码过程中的错误传播.
实验表明,在保持常规源编码的性能和效率的同时,联合编码比单独优化的优势在于,SemQAM在感知度量下比比较的JSC方法表现得更好.

At the same time, concentrating probability on these higher-energy symbols also increases the noise power through Eq. 7 .
The optimized distribution therefore balances this geometric robustness against the corresponding increase in noise and the need to use sufficiently many distinct symbols.

blocks.en: B.1 Model Architecture
blocks.zh: B.1 示范建筑

blocks.en:
SemQAM builds on EF-LIC [ 10 ] , retaining its image transforms, hyperprior, four-group quadtree context model, and projected RVQ.
The architecture is shown in Fig. 6 .
The main latent and hyperlatent contain 256 and 128 channels, respectively, while the transform and context modules use a hidden width of 384.
Each main-latent RVQ contains 1024 codewords in a 16-dimensional search space, and each hyperlatent RVQ contains 1024 codewords in an 8-dimensional search space.

SemQAM基于EF-LIC [10],保留其图像变换,超前,四组四棵树上下文模型,以及预测的RVQ.

主要潜伏和超纬度分别包含256道和128道,而变形和上下文模块则使用384道的隐藏宽度.
每个主线 RVQ在16维搜索空间中包含1024个代码,每个超纬度的RVQ在8维搜索空间中包含1024个代码.

Figure 6 : Framework of SemQAM.

The hyper synthesis transform produces both q q and the context features, with q q constrained to be positive and clamped below at 0.5 0.5 .

Each quadtree branch combines the hyperprior support with previously reconstructed groups to predict the mean and scale of the current group.
The four branches map their context features to a 384-channel hidden representation, and the shared predictor outputs a 256-channel mean and a 256-channel scale.

blocks.en:
The hyperprior and quadtree autoregressive context are core components of the efficient image codec considered here rather than auxiliary modules introduced for SemQAM.
The hyperlatent is transmitted first and determines the normalization and context used for main-latent quantization, while each quadtree group uses previously reconstructed groups to predict the next group.
These dependencies reduce coding redundancy, but they also allow an earlier detection error to change subsequent quantization.
blocks.zh:
超前和四面体自动递归上下文是此处考虑的高效图像编码的核心组件,而不是SemQAM引入的辅助模块.
超纬度首先被传递,决定了主纬度量化所用的常态和上下文,而每个四棵树组则使用之前重建的组来预测下一个组.
这些依赖性减少了编码冗余性,但也允许更早的检测错误改变之后的量化.

blocks.en:
Removing only the quadtree autoregressive context does not remove this dependency because errors in the hyperlatent can still change the quantization of the main latent.
Only when both the hyperprior and quadtree autoregressive context are removed is this cross-group error propagation eliminated.
In this simplified setting, the receiver-side codebook update has the same transition-weighted expectation as CAVQ [ 36 ] .
Removing these components therefore simplifies away the error propagation that SemQAM is designed to handle rather than providing a matched evaluation of the full image codec.
For brevity, when discussing error propagation in the main text, we use autoregressive coding as shorthand for this context-dependent coding process involving both the hyperprior and quadtree autoregressive context.
blocks.zh:
只删除四面体自动递减上下文并不能消除这种依赖性,因为超纬度中的错误仍然可以改变主潜伏的量化.
只有当超前端和四面体自递性上下文被删除时,这种跨组错误传播才会被消除.
在这个简化的设置中,接收器侧代码簿更新的过渡加权预期值与CAVQ[36]相同.
因此,删除这些组件就简化了SemQAM旨在处理而不是提供完整图像编码器的匹配评价的错误传播。
为简洁起见,在讨论正文中的错误传播时,我们使用自旋编码作为上下文依赖的编码进程的简称,其中既包括超前编码,也包括四面体自旋式编码。

blocks.en: Appendix C Training and Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 附录C 培训和评价议定书

blocks.en:
This section specifies the training and evaluation protocols used throughout the experiments.
It covers multi-operating-point optimization, dataset preprocessing, baseline inference settings, separated transmission, metric computation, channel-noise stability, and the matched protocol used for the ablation study.
blocks.zh:
本节具体说明了在整个试验过程中使用的培训和评价规程。
它涵盖多操作点优化,数据集预处理,基线推论设置,分离传输,计量计算,信道噪声稳定性,以及衰减研究所使用的匹配协议.

blocks.en: C.1 Training Protocol
blocks.zh: C.1 培训议定书

blocks.en:
SemQAM supports four CBR settings for each of 10 dB, 16 dB, 24 dB, and noiseless transmission.
Each SNR–CBR pair defines one operating point with its own VQ codebooks, while the image transforms, hyperprior, and context networks are shared across all sixteen operating points.
To stably optimize these operating points, we adopt a three-stage training strategy on ImageNet using one NVIDIA RTX 4090.
First, the shared model is trained for 0.3 0.3 M iterations at a learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} , randomly selecting one of the four 10 dB operating points for each batch.
Second, the shared backbone is frozen and each of the remaining twelve operating points is trained for 0.06 0.06 M iterations at 10 − 4 10^{-4} .
Finally, the complete model is jointly fine-tuned for 1 1 M iterations at 10 − 5 10^{-5} , randomly selecting one of all sixteen operating points for each batch.
This staged schedule provides stable optimization across multiple operating points and is not required by the model architecture.
The reported models use a random seed of 1926.
blocks.zh:
SemQAM为10 dB,16 dB,24 dB各支持4个CBR设置,以及无噪声传输.
每个SNR-CBR对都用自己的VQ编码本定义了一个操作点,而图像转换,超前,和上下文网络则在所有16个操作点共享.
为了稳定优化这些操作点,我们采用了一个使用NVIDIA RTX 4090的图像网络三阶段培训战略。
首先,共享模型为0.3 0.3 M的迭代训练,学习率为10−4 10^{-4},随机选择每批四个10 dB操作点中的一个.
第二,共享骨干被冻结,其余12个操作点的每个操作点都接受0.06 0.06 M重迭10 - 4 10 QQ-4}的培训。
最后,完整型号在10 − 5 10 → 5 → 11 M迭代时共同微调,随机选择每批16个操作点中的一个.
这个分阶段的时间表提供了跨多个操作点的稳定优化,而并不是模型架构所要求的.
报告模型使用1926年的随机种子.

blocks.en:
We further train SemQAM using five random seeds that independently initialize both the network parameters and VQ codebooks.
The resulting models converge to similar QAM shaping patterns and final performance.
This behavior is consistent with the permutation symmetry of VQ, where the initial codeword indices are arbitrary labels.
Receiver-side codebook learning subsequently organizes these labels according to the channel transition structure, making the converged shaping behavior insensitive to the initial codeword ordering.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步使用五个随机种子来训练SemQAM,这些种子独立初始化了网络参数和VQ编码本.
由此产生的模型与类似的QAM塑造模式和最终性能趋同.
这种行为与VQ的通俗对称一致,其中最初的编码词索引是任意的标签.
接收者-侧代码本学习之后根据通道过渡结构来组织这些标签,使聚合的塑造行为对初始代码命令不敏感.

blocks.en: C.2 Datasets and Preprocessing
blocks.zh: C.2 数据集和预处理

blocks.en:
We evaluate SemQAM on Kodak, Tecnick, DIV2K validation, and CLIC 2020 Professional.
Kodak contains 24 images at 512 × 768 512\times 768 or 768 × 512 768\times 512 , and Tecnick contains 100 images at 1200 × 1200 1200\times 1200 .
We use all 100 DIV2K validation images and 250 CLIC 2020 Professional images at their original resolutions.
Images are processed as RGB without resizing.
When padding is required for inference, the transmitted representation includes the padded positions, while the reconstruction is cropped to the original image size before quality evaluation.
The original image dimensions are used in the CBR denominator.
blocks.zh:
我们评价SemQAM在Kodak,Tecnick,DIV2K验证,以及CLIC2020专业.
Kodak在512×768 512\times 768或768×512 768\times 512中包含24幅图像,Tecnick在1200×1200\times 1200中包含100幅图像.
我们使用全部100张DIV2K验证图像和250张CLIC 2020专业图像的原始分辨率.
图像作为RGB处理而无需调整大小.
当需要加载推导时,传输的表示包括加载位置,而重建则在质量评价前被裁剪为原始图像大小.
最初的图像维度在CBR分母中使用.

blocks.en: C.3 Baseline Inference Protocol
blocks.zh: C.3 基线推论议定书

blocks.en:
For NTSCC, NTSCC+, and MDJCM-A, we use the official publicly released implementations and checkpoints provided by the original authors.
Quad-JSCC does not publicly release the corresponding perceptual-quality model, so we directly contacted the authors and corresponding author and obtained the LPIPS-optimized weights used in our evaluation.
Each method is evaluated through its original transmission interface, with all required transmitted side information included in CBR.
blocks.zh:
对于NTSC、NTSC+和MDJCM-A, 我们使用原作者提供的官方公开执行和检查站。
Quad-JSCC没有公开发布相应的知觉质量模型,因此我们直接与作者和相应的作者联系,获得了我们评价中使用的LPIPS-优化加权.
每种方法都通过其原始传输接口进行评估,所有所需的传输侧信息都包含在CBR中.

blocks.en:
NTSCC uses four officially released distortion-optimized operating points, while NTSCC+ uses five released operating points with fixed model weights and no online model optimization.
The MDJCM authors publicly release only MDJCM-A.
This analog variant serves as the upper-performance reference of the MDJCM family, so using MDJCM-A provides a strong comparison rather than a favorable setting for SemQAM.
Quad-JSCC is evaluated using the perceptual-quality model obtained from its authors.
blocks.zh:
NTSCC使用四个官方发布的扭曲优化操作点,而NTSCC+使用五个已发布的操作点,具有固定的模型权重,没有在线模型优化.
MDJCM作者只公开发布MDJCM-A.
这个模拟变体作为MDJCM家族的上等性能参考,因此使用MDJCM-A为SemQAM提供了一个强烈的比较而不是有利的设置.
Quad-JSCC使用从其作者那里获得的感知质量模型进行评估.

blocks.en:
For rate accounting, NTSCC includes the transmitted main symbols and the prescribed rate-index side cost.
NTSCC+ additionally transmits its side representation through the official PNG coding interface with rate- 2 / 3 2/3 LDPC and 16-QAM protection.
For Quad-JSCC, active real-valued main features are paired into complex channel symbols, while its encoded side information uses the selected 10 dB MCS.
MDJCM-A is evaluated through its official analog transmission interface.
blocks.zh:
对于费率核算,NTSC包括传输的主要符号和规定的费率指数边成本.
NTSC+通过PNG官方编码接口额外传输其侧面代表,其比例为-2 / 3 2/3 LDPC和16-QAM保护.
对于Quad-JSCC,活动真实值的主要功能被对成复杂的通道符号,而其编码的侧信息则使用选定的10 dB MCS.
MDJCM-A通过其官方的模拟传输接口进行评估.

blocks.en:
The separated source-codec baselines include MS-ILLM, OSCAR, OneDC, DiT-IC, EF-LIC, and CoD-Lite.
For all methods, we use the officially released implementations and pretrained checkpoints and follow their provided coding and inference procedures.
Their measured source rates, including the required source side information, are converted to channel uses using the common separated-transmission protocol in Sec. C.4 .
The noiseless SemQAM source codec is evaluated through the same conversion to provide a matched separated reference.
blocks.zh:
分离的源代码基线包括MS-ILLM,OSCAR,OneDC,DiT-IC,EF-LIC,以及CoD-Lite.
就所有方法而言,我们使用正式发布的执行和预先训练的检查站,并遵循它们提供的编码和推断程序。
其测量的源速率,包括所需的源侧信息,被转换为使用Sec.C.4中常见的分离传输协议的通道使用.
通过相同的转换来评价无噪声的SemQAM源代码,以提供匹配的分离引用.

blocks.en:
For runtime evaluation, each baseline retains the numerical precision, inference backend, and acceleration strategy provided by its official implementation.
For example, OneDC follows its official path with BF16 autocast for the feedforward and codec networks while retaining the large VAE in FP32, and CoD-Lite follows its official BF16 inference path.
Other methods likewise use their released implementation settings rather than being rewritten under a common backend.
This protocol evaluates the realized performance of each available codec implementation while preserving its intended execution path.
blocks.zh:
对于运行时间评价,每个基线都保留其正式执行所提供的数字精确度、推论后端和加速战略。
例如,OneDC在FP32中保留大型VAE的同时,沿用其官方路径,为feedforward和codec网络使用BF16自动播报,CoD-Lite遵循其官方BF16推断路径.
其他方法同样使用其发布的实施设置,而不是在共同的后端重写。
本协议评价每个可用代码执行的实现性能,同时保留其预定执行路径.

blocks.en:
For CoD-Lite, we use the official 0.0312 0.0312 bpp checkpoint and configuration.
We observe that measurements from the released implementation differ from the latency values reported in its paper.
At the 1024 × 1920 1024\times 1920 reference resolution used by CoD-Lite, the official checkpoint takes 39.52 39.52 ms for encoding and 56.86 56.86 ms for decoding on our NVIDIA A100 evaluation, compared with the reported 16 16 ms and 24 24 ms.
We therefore use measurements from the released code under our common hardware and timing protocol rather than mixing them with separately reported values.
Under the unified 1080 × 1920 1080\times 1920 evaluation used in our high-resolution comparison, CoD-Lite takes 42.37 42.37 ms for encoding and 60.47 60.47 ms for decoding, whereas SemQAM takes 15.49 15.49 ms and 22.71 22.71 ms, corresponding to 2.74 × 2.74\times and 2.66 × 2.66\times speedups, respectively.
blocks.zh:
对于CoD-Lite,我们使用官方的0.0312 0.0312 bpp检查站和配置.
我们注意到,对所公布执行情况的衡量不同于其文件中报告的延迟值。
在CoD-Lite使用的1024×1920 1024\times 1920的参考解析中,官方检查站的编码需要39.52 39.52 ms,我国的NVIDIA A100评价的解码需要56.86 56.86 ms,相比之下,所报告的16 16 ms和24 ms.
因此,我们使用我们共同硬件和计时协议下发布的代码的测量标准,而不是将它们与单独报告的数值混合。
根据我们高清比较所使用的统一1080×1920 1080\时的1920评价,CoD-Lite的编码需要42.3742.37ms,解码需要60.4760.47ms,而SemQAM的编码需要15.49 15.49ms和22.71 22.71ms,分别对应2.74×2.74\时和2.66×2.6x时的速度.

blocks.en:
SemQAM is evaluated with its optimized CUDA implementation under the same principle.
Its CUDA acceleration is part of the proposed codec implementation, while competing methods retain the optimization paths supplied by their official releases.
We report parameter count and FLOPs separately as architecture-level costs, and measured latency as complete implementation-level performance.
blocks.zh:
对SemQAM的评价是,在同样的原则下,它优化了CUDA的实施。
它的CUDA加速是拟议代码执行的一部分,而相互竞争的方法则保留其官方发布所提供的优化路径.
我们分别将参数计数和FLOP报告为架构级成本,并将耐久性衡量为完整执行级绩效.

blocks.en: C.4 Separated Transmission Protocol
blocks.zh: C.4 分离传输协议

Each operating point specifies a modulation order M M and nominal channel-code rate R R .
For a source rate of b b bits per pixel, the corresponding channel bandwidth ratio is CBR = b 3 ​ R ​ log 2 ⁡ M . \mathrm{CBR}=\frac{b}{3R\log_{2}M}. The source payload and all source-side information required for reconstruction are included in b b .

每个操作点指定一个调制命令M M和标称的通道码速率R R.
对于每个像素的b b 比特的源速率,相应的通道带宽比为CBR=b 3 R log 2岁 \ mathrm{ CBR\ frac{ b\\ 3R\ log\ 2} M} 。 重建所需的源有效载荷和所有源侧信息载于bb。

The 10 dB evaluation uses MCS 16.
For 16 and 24 dB, we use the available 5G-LENA reference BLER curves [ 11 ] and select the highest nominal spectral efficiency whose BLER does not exceed 0.01 0.01 at the evaluated SNR.

blocks.en:
The separated evaluation uses the reconstruction obtained after successful protected-bitstream decoding.
The selected LDPC rate therefore determines the required channel resources, while image quality is evaluated from the recovered source representation.
blocks.zh:
分离的评价使用成功保护-比特流解码后获得的重建.
因此,选定的LDPC率决定了所需的频道资源,而图像质量则从恢复的源代表来评价.

blocks.en: C.5 Evaluation Protocol and Metric Computation
blocks.zh: C.5 评价协议和计算

blocks.en:
We use 10 dB as the primary channel condition for comparison with learned JSCC methods.
A fixed SNR of 10 dB has been widely used for rate–quality evaluation in representative image JSCC systems, including DeepJSCC-f, DeepJSCC-Q, NTSCC, NTSCC+, SwinJSCC, MDJCM, and Quad-DeepSC [ 34 , 45 , 13 , 47 , 51 , 53 , 26 ] .
In particular, these works commonly evaluate reconstruction quality across different bandwidth or CBR settings under this channel condition.
All learned JSCC baselines included in our main comparison also provide an available official checkpoint or author-provided model at 10 dB, whereas model availability at other SNRs is incomplete across the compared methods.
We therefore use 10 dB for the main comparison to maximize baseline coverage while remaining aligned with established JSCC evaluation settings.
SemQAM additionally supports 16 dB and 24 dB, for which we report separate results to evaluate its performance under other channel conditions.
blocks.zh:
我们使用10 dB作为与所学的JSC方法进行比较的主要通道条件.
以具有代表性的JSCC系统,包括DeepJSCC-f、DeepJSCC-Q、NTSC、NTSC+、SwinJSC、MDJCM和Quad-DeepSC, 广泛采用10 dB的固定SNR进行比率质量评价。
尤其是,这些作品在这个通道条件下通常会评价不同带宽或CBR设置的重建质量.
我们的主要比较中包括的所有学到的JSCC基线也提供了10分贝的可用官方检查点或作者提供的模型,而其他SNR的模型可用性则在比较方法上不完整。
因此,我们使用10 dB进行主要比较,以尽量扩大基线覆盖面,同时保持与既定的JSC评价环境保持一致。
SemQAM额外支持16 dB和24 dB,为此我们报告单独的结果,以评估它在其他通道条件下的性能.

blocks.en:
We use standardized objective perceptual metrics as the primary quantitative evaluation.
Although subjective user studies can provide complementary perceptual evidence, their results depend on the participant population, viewing conditions, presentation protocol, and selected test cases, and naturally exhibit inter-observer variability.
Moreover, repeated evaluations may produce different scores even with the same participants and experimental conditions, making subjective results difficult to reproduce exactly.
These factors make subjective scores less suitable for reproducible and fine-grained comparisons across many methods, datasets, and operating points.
In contrast, standardized objective metrics provide repeatable measurements under a fixed evaluation protocol.
This practice is also widely adopted in generative image compression: representative published methods including MS-ILLM, GLC, Control-GIC, DLF, OneDC, OSCAR, and RDVQ primarily evaluate perceptual reconstruction using objective metrics such as LPIPS, DISTS, and FID without reporting a subjective user study [ 38 , 29 , 35 , 49 , 50 , 23 , 31 ] .
We therefore follow this established evaluation practice and use LPIPS and DISTS to measure reference-based perceptual fidelity and FID to measure distribution-level realism, together with qualitative reconstructions for visual inspection.
blocks.zh:
我们使用标准化的客观概念衡量标准作为初级定量评估。
虽然主观的用户研究可以提供互补的知觉证据,但其结果取决于参与者群,查看条件,展示协议,以及选定的测试案例,并自然表现出观测者之间的可变性.
此外,重复评价即使有相同的参与者和实验条件,也可能产生不同的分数,使得主观结果难以准确复制.
这些因素使得主观分数更不适合在许多方法,数据集和操作点之间进行可复制和精细的比较.
与此相反,标准化的目标衡量标准根据固定评价协议提供可重复的衡量标准。
这种做法在基因图像压缩中也得到广泛采用:包括MS-ILLM,GLC,Control-GIC,DLF,OneDC,OSCAR,和RDVQ在内的代表性发布方法主要使用LPIPS,DISTS等客观度量评价知觉重建,FID则不报告主观用户研究[38,29,35,49,50,23,31].
因此,我们遵循这一既定的评估做法,利用LPIPS和DISTS来衡量基于参考的观念的忠诚度和FID来衡量分配层面的现实性,以及用于视觉检查的质量重建。

blocks.en:
We evaluate perceptual reconstruction using LPIPS with the VGG feature network [ 54 , 43 ] and DISTS [ 15 ] .
Both metrics are computed for each reconstructed image and then averaged over the complete dataset.
blocks.zh:
我们用LPIPS与VGG特征网络[54,43]和DISTS[15]来评价视觉重建.
每个重建的图像都计算出两个指标,然后对完整的数据集进行平均值。

blocks.en:
SemQAM targets generative perceptual reconstruction rather than distortion-optimal reconstruction.
The established perception–distortion tradeoff shows that improving perceptual quality can require increased pixel-level distortion, and its rate-constrained extension further establishes a rate–distortion–perception tradeoff for lossy compression [ 6 , 7 ] .
PSNR therefore measures a different optimization objective and is not used as the primary criterion for the perceptually optimized setting considered here.
blocks.zh:
SemQAM的目标是基因感知重建,而不是扭曲-优化重建。
既定的认知-扭曲权衡表明,提高知觉质量可能需要增加像素水平的扭曲,其速率限制延伸进一步确立了损失压缩的速率-扭曲-认知权衡[6,7].
因此,PSNR衡量的是不同的优化目标,不作为本文所考虑的感知优化设置的首要标准。

blocks.en:
This distinction is particularly relevant to the learned JSCC baselines.
Representative methods such as NTSCC and NTSCC+ are primarily optimized and reported under distortion-oriented objectives and PSNR-based evaluation [ 13 , 47 ] .
A PSNR comparison with these models would therefore mainly reflect different operating points on the perception–distortion tradeoff rather than provide a matched evaluation of generative perceptual reconstruction.
To retain a direct comparison within the JSCC family under a perceptual objective, we additionally evaluate Quad-JSCC using the LPIPS-optimized model provided by its authors [ 26 ] .
Together with the generative image compression baselines, this provides comparisons with methods optimized toward the same perceptual objective as SemQAM.
blocks.zh:
这种区分与已获得的JSC基线特别相关。
NTSC和NTSCC+等代表性方法主要在扭曲导向目标和基于PSNR的评价下进行优化和报告[13,47].
因此,PSNR与这些模型的比较将主要反映感知-扭曲权衡的不同操作点,而不是对基因感知重建提供相应的评价。
为了在JSCC家庭内保持直接的比较,我们利用作者提供的LPIPS优化模式,对Quad-JSCC进行额外评价[26].
这与基因图像压缩基线一起,提供了与SemQAM相同的感知目标优化方法的比较。

blocks.en:
Following the patch-based FID evaluation protocol of GLC [ 29 ] , we compute FID over local image patches rather than directly over the full images.
We use a patch size of 64 × 64 64\times 64 for Kodak and 256 × 256 256\times 256 for the higher-resolution Tecnick, DIV2K, and CLIC 2020 datasets.
For each dataset and operating point, patches from all reference images and their reconstructions are accumulated to estimate the corresponding feature distributions, from which FID is computed using Inception features.
This patch-based protocol increases the number of feature samples and provides a more stable distribution-level evaluation on small image test sets.
The figures use a base-two logarithmic vertical axis for visualization, while all numerical comparisons and BD-rate calculations use the original FID values.
blocks.zh:
在GLC[29]基于补丁的FID评价协议之后,我们将FID计算在局部图像补丁上而不是直接计算在全图像上.
科达克使用64×64 64\times 64的补丁大小,高分辨率Tecnick使用256×256\times 256的补丁大小,DIV2K和CLIC 2020数据集.
对于每个数据集和操作点,所有参考图像及其重建的补丁都累积起来,以估计相应的特征分布,从中FID使用Inception特性计算.
这种基于补丁的协议增加了特征样本的数量,为小图像测试集提供了更稳定的分布级评价.
数字使用基二对数垂直轴进行可视化,而所有数值比较和BD率计算则使用原始的FID值.

blocks.en:
We use BD-rate [ 5 ] to summarize the average difference in channel uses between two rate–quality curves at matched reconstruction quality.
For each comparison, one method is selected as the anchor and is therefore assigned a BD-rate of 0.00 % 0.00\% .
We interpolate log 10 ⁡ ( CBR ) \log_{10}(\mathrm{CBR}) as a function of the original quality metric using piecewise cubic Hermite interpolation (PCHIP) over the common quality interval.
Let a ⁡ ( q ) a(q) and b ⁡ ( q ) b(q) denote the interpolated log-CBR curves of the anchor and comparison method over [ q 0 , q 1 ] [q_{0},q_{1}] .
The reported BD-rate is BD ​ - ​ rate = 100 ​ [ 10 1 q 1 − q 0 ​ ∫ q 0 q 1 ( b ⁡ ( q ) − a ⁡ ( q ) ) ​ 𝑑 q − 1 ] . \operatorname{BD\text{-}rate}=100\left[10^{\frac{1}{q_{1}-q_{0}}\int_{q_{0}}^{q_{1}}(b(q)-a(q))\,dq}-1\right]. A negative BD-rate means that the comparison method requires fewer channel uses than the anchor to achieve the same quality on average, while a positive value means that it requires more.
For example, a BD-rate of − 20 % -20\% indicates approximately 20 % 20\% fewer channel uses at matched quality.
The main comparisons use SemQAM-C with LDPC and QAM as the anchor.
Only measured points within a valid common quality interval are used for interpolation, and comparisons without a valid interval are reported as unavailable.
C.6 Evaluation Stability
blocks.zh: C.6 评价稳定性

blocks.en:
We evaluate the sensitivity of the final model to AWGN realizations by fixing the model weights, inputs, operating points, and transmission protocol and varying only the channel noise.
The experiment covers all 24 Kodak images, all sixteen operating points, and ten AWGN seeds, giving 3840 reconstructions.
For each operating point and seed, we first average the metric over the 24 images and then compute the sample standard deviation across the ten dataset-level means.
At 10 dB and CBR 0.005534 0.005534 , the standard deviations are 0.0219 0.0219 dB for PSNR and 0.000463 0.000463 for LPIPS.
At CBR 0.020752 0.020752 , the corresponding values are 0.0087 0.0087 dB and 0.000165 0.000165 .
These small variations show that the reported dataset-average performance is stable across the evaluated channel realizations.
The noiseless operating points have zero variation.
blocks.zh:
我们通过确定模型的权重、输入、操作点和传输协议,并仅改变信道噪声,来评价最终模型对特设工作组实现的敏感性。
实验覆盖了全部24个柯达图像,全部16个操作点,以及10个AWGN种子,给出了3840次重建.
对于每个操作点和种子,我们首先在24个图像上平均度量,然后计算10个数据集水平的样本标准偏差。
在10 dB和CBR 0.005534 0.005534,标准差为PSNR的0.0219 0.0219 dB,LPIPS的0.000463 0.0000463.
在CBR 0.020752 0.020752中,相应的数值为0.0087 0.0087 dB和0.000165 0.000165。
这些小的变化表明,所报告的数据集平均性能在整个被评价的频道实现中是稳定的。
无噪声操作点零变异.

The ablation configurations follow Tab. 2 in the main paper. M 0 \mathrm{M}_{0} removes both the hyperprior and quadtree autoregression. M 1 \mathrm{M}_{1} uses the same configuration with a deeper backbone, while M 2 \mathrm{M}_{2} restores the hyperprior without quadtree autoregression.

blocks.en: Appendix D Additional Experimental Results
blocks.zh: 附录D 其他实验结果

blocks.en:
This section extends the main experiments along two dimensions.
We first examine whether the transmission gains generalize across datasets and channel conditions, and then evaluate whether the low computational cost of SemQAM is retained at higher image resolutions.
blocks.zh:
本节将主要实验沿两个维度延伸.
我们首先审查传输是否在数据集和信道条件中普遍化,然后评价SemQAM的低计算成本是否保留在较高的图像分辨率。

blocks.en: D.1 Additional Datasets and Channel Conditions
blocks.zh: D.1 其他数据集和通道条件

blocks.en:
Tab. 4 reports 10 dB BD-rates for representative JSCC and GIC methods across all four datasets.
Relative to the matched SemQAM-C baseline, SemQAM achieves negative BD-rates in LPIPS, DISTS, and FID on every dataset.
The gains are particularly consistent in LPIPS, remaining close to 19% across Kodak, Tecnick, DIV2K, and CLIC 2020.
This consistency shows that the benefit of native joint training is not specific to the Kodak test set, but generalizes across image datasets with different resolutions and content.
Missing entries indicate comparisons without a valid common quality interval for interpolation.

4份报告 所有四个数据集中有代表性的JSC和GIC方法的10 dB BD率.

Figs. 7 and 8 further extend the comparison to 16 and 24 dB using the MCS settings in Tab. 3 .
Across these additional channel conditions, SemQAM continues to provide competitive perceptual reconstruction through the same standard QAM interface.
More importantly, the native SemQAM curves remain consistently improved over the matched SemQAM-C baseline, showing that adapting the source representation to the channel remains beneficial beyond the 10 dB operating point.
Together, these results indicate that the gains from joint coding are stable across both image datasets and channel conditions.

The SemQAM entries average all sixteen operating points at each resolution, and all methods use batch size one on A100 with their respective inference implementations.

blocks.en:
SemQAM maintains the lowest encoding and decoding latency among the compared methods at every evaluated resolution.
This advantage is preserved as the image size increases rather than being limited to the relatively small benchmark images used in the main experiments.
At 4K, SemQAM requires 55.86 ms for encoding and 87.18 ms for decoding, while its peak GPU memory remains below 1 GiB.
The modest increase in memory together with the sustained latency advantage shows that the lightweight design scales efficiently to high-resolution image transmission.
blocks.zh:
SemQAM在每种评估分辨率的比较方法中保持最低编码和解码间隔。
随着图像大小的增加,而不是局限于主要实验中使用的相对较小的基准图像,这一优势得以保留.
在4K时,SemQAM需要55.86ms的编码和87.18ms的解码,而它的峰值GPU内存仍然低于1GiB.
内存的适度增加以及持续的耐久优势表明,轻量级设计能高效地达到高分辨率图像传输.

blocks.en: Appendix E Visual Comparison
blocks.zh: 附录E 视觉比较

blocks.en:
Figs. 9 and 10 provide additional visual comparisons with previous methods.
In all selected examples, SemQAM achieves both lower CBR and lower LPIPS than the compared methods while preserving more recognizable local structures.
blocks.zh:
数数. 9和10提供了与以往方法的额外视觉对比.
在所选的所有例子中,SemQAM既实现了比比较方法更低的CBR,也实现了更低的LPIPS,同时保留了更可识别的本地结构.

blocks.en:
In Fig. 9 , the enlarged regions show differences in thin lines and regular structures.
For the butterfly image, SemQAM preserves the thin vein inside the wing with a continuous shape, while some compared methods blur or simplify this structure.
For the road image, the faint yellow center line remains visible in the SemQAM reconstruction, whereas it becomes weaker or disappears in several compared results.
For the building image, SemQAM retains the horizontal lines of the window blinds, while these lines are less distinguishable in the other reconstructions.
A similar difference can be observed in the castle image, where the divisions inside the window remain clearer with SemQAM.
blocks.zh:
以法义. 9,扩大的区域显示细线和常规结构的差异.
对于蝴蝶图像来说,SemQAM以连续的形状保留了翼内薄静脉,而一些比较的方法模糊或简化了这种结构.
就道路图像而言,昏暗的黄色中线在SemQAM重建中仍然可见,而在几个比较结果中则变得较弱或消失.
对于建筑图像来说,SemQAM保留了窗盲的横向线条,而这些线条在其他重建中则不太能区分.
在城堡的图像中也可以看到类似的差异,在其中,窗口内的分裂与SemQAM保持清晰.

blocks.en:
Fig. 10 further compares SemQAM with recent generative image codecs.
For the glasses, the nose pad reconstructed by SemQAM remains close to the elliptical shape and internal structure in the original image, while OneDC reconstructs it as a simpler open ring.
For the railing, SemQAM preserves the repeated X patterns and their connections, whereas CoD-Lite and OSCAR show stronger distortion and merging between the bars.
The enlarged sculpture region also shows that SemQAM retains the curved boundaries and separation between neighboring structures more clearly.
These examples show that the lower LPIPS of SemQAM is accompanied by better preservation of object parts, thin structures, and regular geometric patterns while using fewer channel resources.
blocks.zh:
图10进一步比较了SemQAM与近代基因图像解码器.
对于眼镜来说,SemQAM重建的鼻垫仍然与原始图像中的椭圆形状和内部结构相近,而OneDC则将其重建为更简单的开放环.
对于栏杆,SemQAM保留了重复的X图案及其连接,而CoD-Lite和OSCAR则表现出更强烈的扭曲和条间合并.
扩大的雕塑区还表明,SemQAM保留了曲折的边界,并更明确地区分了邻近的结构.
这些例子表明,SemQAM的LPIPS下位伴随着对象部件保存较好,结构细薄,常规几何图案,同时使用较少的通道资源.
